evals.prompt: Add Next.js App Router liveness, readiness, startup, diagnostics, and Prometheus metrics routes using an existing health manager.
evals.expected_output: A route matrix implemented with one server-only manager, correct factory methods, runtime constants, status policies, and tests.
expectations: Exports GET/HEAD for health routes and GET only for metrics.
Uses explicit scopes, no-store route constants, and one manager singleton.
Protects diagnostics and metrics or records an explicit internal control.

evals.prompt: Readiness should return 503 when degraded, while metrics must remain scrapeable with HTTP 200 and expose report status in headers.
evals.expected_output: Strict readiness policy plus fixed metrics transport semantics with focused tests.

evals.prompt: Review a diagnostics route built with protect {}, includeDetails true, IP CIDRs without trustProxy, and custom cache-control public headers.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed review that rejects construction and restores protected sanitized no-store behavior.
expectations: Rejects empty protection and IP/CIDR without trustProxy.
Does not treat includeDetails as raw error/stack exposure.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why HEAD is slow, why it has no body, and why the Prometheus route returns 200 while the report is unhealthy.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded explanation of manager execution for HEAD and fixed metrics HTTP transport behavior.
expectations: Explains that HEAD still runs the manager/status logic.
Treats the empty HEAD body as intentional.
Uses x-health-status for unhealthy metrics state.

evals.prompt: Change Prometheus metric normalization, label allowlisting, HELP output, and OpenTelemetry record mapping without changing any Next route.
evals.expected_output: A handoff to monitoring exporters rather than modifying route wiring.
expectations: Recognizes exporter conversion as the primary boundary.
Composes with healthcheck-monitoring-exporters if the route consumes changed output.
Does not put exporter logic in Next route files.
